audit.whatIsWrong: Chart handed Volibear every row from level 2 through first item, including level 6, while whys[2] says the kits 'match', whys[4] says Hijacking Stormbringer flips the lane, and whys[5] says extended brawls tilt to Sylas. Packet chart reads Volibear, Volibear, Skill, Skill, Sylas, Skill, Skill.
audit.why: Volibear genuinely owns levels 1-2: his Q stun and a 5-second Frenzied Maul arrive before Sylas has E. From level 3 both kits are complete and the trade is close. Level 6 is a Sylas swing because a stolen Stormbringer costs him nothing while his own is on 160 seconds.
audit.corrected: Rows realigned to Volibear, Volibear, Skill, Skill, Sylas, Skill, Skill in both layers, with ratings rescaled.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Volibear's level 1-2 window, level 6 Hijacked Stormbringer, the level 3-5 full-kit parity, and Riftmaker. Ordering by 'when' labels is unusual but each timing is accurate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sky Splitter (E) appears nowhere on the page — not in the interactions, the trading rules, or any why. It is a 1200-range lightning bolt that slows and, if he stands in the blast, shields him. Thundering Smash's auto-attack reset is also never named, and Frenzied Maul's healing is described without ever mentioning Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Sky Splitter's shield is what eats a Sylas all-in that was counted as lethal, and its slow is how he closes to Q range in the first place. The Q auto-reset is the actual visual cue to disengage — a player watching for 'the ability cast' reacts a beat too late.
audit.corrected: Sky Splitter written into whys[3] and the mid text as the thing to bait before spending E2; Thundering Smash named as an auto-reset with its 12-second cooldown; Grievous Wounds made the prerequisite for the extended brawl.
sources: _kits/volibear.json E (1200 range, shield, slow, 16s), Q (autoReset, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10), W (5s, heal, onHit)

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treated Thundering Smash as the matchup-defining cooldown without ever stating its length.
audit.why: 12 seconds at rank 1 is a short window; advice to 'wait for it' means nothing without the number, and it changes whether a hook is worth spending.
audit.corrected: 12-second figure written into the mid text and dosFull[0].d.

audit.why: Packet flagged wants.foe[0] 'Land Thundering Smash' as a suspect name; it is Volibear's real Q. False positive, untouched. Sylas's Chain Lash, Abscond and Abduct are all used correctly throughout.

edits.before: Level 1 is purely his — Volibear's passive lightning ramps through short trades and you have no answer yet, so last-hit with Q Chain Lash at max range and decline every auto. At 2 his Q Thundering Smash run-down stun pairs with W Frenzied Maul bite-heal into a burst combo you cannot reliably escape before your E is live; respect the walk-up completely and do not step past the wave. Reach level 2 yourself as fast as possible — getting your E Abscond online is the single benchmark that makes this lane playable.
edits.after: Level 1 is purely his — Volibear's passive lightning ramps through short trades and you have no answer yet, so last-hit with Q Chain Lash at max range and decline every auto. At 2 his Thundering Smash run-down stun pairs with Frenzied Maul, a 5-second cooldown that heals him on every second cast into the same target, and you cannot escape that burst before your E is live. His Q is an auto-reset, so back off on the wind-up rather than the cast. Reach level 2 fast — E Abscond online is the benchmark that makes this lane playable.

edits.before: Once you have all three basic abilities, the lane evens out sharply: E2 Abduct into Q slow and W heal matches his stun-bite pattern, and your passive Petricite Burst chain autos during the brawl chip him faster than he expects from an AP bruiser. The key read is Thundering Smash cooldown — when his Q is down he cannot stun you in place for the double-bite, so that is the only window to commit your hook. Level 6 is the turning point: Hijack Stormbringer, pocket the tower-disable, and now every all-in either kills him outright or threatens a tower-dive he cannot reciprocate while you hold his R.
edits.after: Once you have all three basic abilities the lane evens out sharply: E2 Abduct into Q slow and W heal matches his stun-bite pattern, and passive Petricite Burst chain autos chip him faster than he expects from an AP bruiser. The key read is Thundering Smash — 12 seconds, and while it is down he cannot hold you still for the double bite, so that is your only hook window. Expect Sky Splitter as his answer: it shields him if he stands in his own blast, so bait it before you spend E2. Level 6 is the turning point — Hijack Stormbringer, pocket the tower-disable, and every all-in either kills him or threatens a dive he cannot reciprocate while you hold his R.

edits.before: Neither kit has clean disengage — trade only when his Q stun is on cooldown, because the stun lockout is the only reason a full combo beats yours.
edits.after: Sky Splitter slows you from 1200 range and shields him inside its blast — trade only when his Q is down, since the stun lockout is why his combo beats yours.

edits.before: Steal Stormbringer at 6 and use the tower-disable to turn his dive tool into your kill pressure
edits.after: Steal Stormbringer at 6 — his own R is 160 seconds at rank 1, so your copy is a free extra dive

edits.before: Win extended trades with W healing off his missing-health tank pool and passive chain autos between spells
edits.after: Hold Grievous Wounds before the extended brawl — Frenzied Maul heals him on every second cast into you

edits.before: The run-down stun — make distance the moment he starts glowing. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Thundering Smash is an auto-reset — step off on the wind-up, not the cast. Go on its 12s cooldown.

notes: Sky Splitter (E) was completely absent from this matchup page despite being a 1200-range slow that shields him inside the blast — that is the ability most likely to make a counted-lethal Sylas all-in fail, and it is now stated. Packet suspectName for wants.foe[0] is a false positive. Items named in the existing text (Sundered Sky, Riftmaker omnivamp) were left alone: I could not verify their current state on 26.15 from the kit data, and they are not ability names.
